# streamengine

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/app/streamengine"
```

Package streamengine is what framework/app/stream plugs into kit: the log a streamed topic appends to — the SDK's stream in memory, in the data directory and over SQL —, the consumer groups its subscriptions read it as, and the migration of a stream's tables (issue #826, ADR 0179 step 4's shape). The framework's core imports none of the SDK's stream: it reaches it through plug, and a product that declares no streamed topic links none of it.

Package streamengine — the compile-time proof that the streams are the framework's.
